verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official local and hosted remote MCP server (verified live via runtime probe requiring only API-token/OAuth auth, no dashboard) plus a documented REST/Events API that lets integrations trigger, acknowledge, and resolve incidents, with escalation policies automating assignment without human/dashboard intervention. Independent probes confirm both the MCP endpoint and Events API v2 are functioning, self-describing endpoints, corroborating vendor docs claims. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP documentation of an 'escalate' action being callable directly (escalation is largely policy-driven rather than an explicit agent-triggered API call), and no independent hands-on account of an agent performing the full ack→escalate→resolve loop end to end.
